memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Abram believed the Lord, and he credited it to him as righteousness. - Gen 15:6 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Here is one of the most important verses in the entire Bible. Abram did nothing. He built nothing, sacrificed nothing, achieved nothing. He simply believed - and God "credited it to him as righteousness." Right standing with God came to Abram as a gift received by faith, not a wage earned by works.

Pause on that word "credited." It is an accounting term - something placed in your account that you did not earn. Abram's righteousness was not something he produced; it was something God reckoned to him because he trusted God's word.

This single verse becomes the foundation of the gospel. Paul quotes it repeatedly: "Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness" (Rom 4:3), and then makes the stunning application - "the words 'it was credited to him' were written not for him alone, but also for us, to whom God will credit righteousness - for us who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead" (Rom 4:23-24).

Do you see? The same way Abram was made right with God is the way you can be. Not by being good enough. Not by religious performance. By believing God's promise - now fulfilled in Christ, who "was delivered over to death for our sins and was raised to life for our justification" (Rom 4:25). Stop trying to earn what God is waiting to credit to you. Believe Him.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Are you trying to earn right standing with God, or receiving it by faith?
- What would change if you truly believed your righteousness is credited, not achieved?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Father, thank You that righteousness is credited to me, not earned by me. I stop striving and simply believe You. Thank You for Jesus, in whom I am counted righteous by faith alone.
Amen.
